page.overview:
Who is Future Goku?

Same as his present timeline counterpart.

Same as his present timeline counterpart.

Future Goku lives the same life as Present Goku until his return to Earth after defeating Future Frieza on Namek. In this timeline, Future Goku uses Instant Transmission to return to Earth, where he successfully kills Future Frieza and Future King Cold when they arrive in August of Age 764.

In a brief cameo in the episode, "Ghosts from Tomorrow", Future Goku can be seen suffering from the lethal heart virus just moments before his death when Future Gohan flashbacks his father Future Goku's death during he and Future Trunks' fight against Future Androids 17 and 18. Knowing that his father was strong (and thought his father was invincible enough to overcome a heart virus; Funimation dub), Future Gohan states his father would have fought courageously against the Androids (and had known how to deal with the Androids; Funimation dub) had he still been alive in their current situation and not died of the heart virus. Future Gohan strives to be just as strong as his father (and brave like him to make his deceased father proud; Funimation dub).
